headline: One position carries the band; the rest return roughly cost.

paragraphs: Acme Robotics accounts for most of the band's value; without it the band is close to 1x.
The gate would have cut the crypto and real-estate positions, both below cost.
lessons_for_gate: Price discipline mattered less than sector discipline in this band.
actions: Ask about a secondary window for Acme Robotics.

Acme Robotics.forecast: A secondary window is more likely than an exit within 24 months.
Acme Robotics.key_risk: Concentration: most of the band's value sits in one illiquid position.
